beats.text: Your Mixture-of-Experts model is wasting 80% of its memory bandwidth just moving weights that never actually fire during decoding.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing neural network where 90% of the nodes are dim, but the memory bus is glowing red-hot with data traffic.

beats.text: SlimWise solves this by decoupling the phases: use the full model for prefill, then switch to a pruned expert pool for decoding.

feynman_certification.listener_verdict: Finally, a tech video that doesn't treat me like a toddler. The hook hit hard because memory bandwidth is actually the biggest bottleneck I deal with when running local LLMs. The librarian analogy in Beat 2 was actually helpful for visualizing the overhead, and you didn't waste time with 'hey guys' or 'in this video'. Beat 4 was the best part—explaining the pointer logic to the KV cache is exactly the kind of low-level detail I look for.
